proposal.reason: Primary change is a new bundled TROCE GIN backend/plugin (host+device GIN implementation, new GIN type/signal semantics, backend selection/discovery, and TROCE context/flush/progress paths), which squarely falls under gin. Add network because shared IB transport/proxy plumbing is substantively changed (new IB provider classification, QP inline/send-with-inv behavior, and net_ib connection paths that can affect transport behavior beyond local plugin wiring). Add build because the PR introduces first-class build/install/package integration for a new shipped shared library (top-level/ext-gin make targets plus Debian/RPM packaging), which is a real packaging/build-system change, not incidental edits.
